# Rotation Captcha Solver / 旋转验证码求解器

> JonyQY/rotation-captcha-solver is a public, open-source Python project for rotation CAPTCHA image-angle estimation, multi-model consensus filtering and slider-offset calculation.

Author: JonyQY. Python package and CLI: spincap, version 1.3.0. Python 3.10+ (64-bit).
The repository includes approximately 384 MB of local ONNX INT8 weights through Git LFS. CPU inference requires no API key or GPU. Install from the repository with `python -m pip install ".[model]"` after cloning and downloading LFS files.

## Authoritative project resources

- [Public source repository](https://github.com/JonyQY/rotation-captcha-solver): source, installation, Python API, JSON CLI, examples, licenses and tests.
- [Project homepage](https://jonyqy.github.io/rotation-captcha-solver/): bilingual overview, video demo and measured timing.
- [README, plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JonyQY/rotation-captcha-solver/main/README.md): complete setup and usage instructions.
- [Agent Skill, plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JonyQY/rotation-captcha-solver/main/.agents/skills/rotation-captcha-solver/SKILL.md): installation, commands, output interpretation and integration.
- [License](https://github.com/JonyQY/rotation-captcha-solver/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT license for project code.
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/JonyQY/rotation-captcha-solver/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): component and model licensing.

## Measured performance

On 2026-11-05, five different images in a consecutive online test passed the CAPTCHA stage (5/5); downstream link submission succeeded in 4/5 cases. Mean warm model inference was 478.82 ms. Fresh-environment model initialization was 4.712 seconds. A subsequent fresh-clone online test passed both stages with 552.97 ms model inference. The project's nominal accuracy is 99%; this is distinct from the recorded sample proportions.

## Invocation

Run `python -m spincap puzzle.png` for JSON output. Reuse `AngleSession` or `python -m spincap --stdio` for successive images. A recognized image angle, a calculated slider offset and a site's final verification result are separate outputs.

This file is a plain-text navigation aid. Use the linked source documents for current API details.
